Until now, the Dykema desk and the Banks enterprise appeared to be parallel structures — both problematic, but not directly connected. Moore managed dark money. Banks ran schools. The desk managed Chatfield’s fund and Nessel’s fund. Banks’ school had an AAG on the board.

But there is a direct connection. And it runs through the Detroit City Council.

The Pipeline: Dark Money → Board Seat

In August 2021, Save Detroit Jobs renamed itself Detroit Leaders — one week after the District 4 primary. Detroit Leaders then issued mailers backing Latisha Johnson for District 4, calling her “the leadership Detroit needs.”

Johnson won.

Johnson is now a Detroit City Council Member — and sits on the Purpose Charter Academy Board of Directors as Secretary.

II. THE FBI CONNECTION

The Raids

In August 2021, the FBI raided the offices of Detroit City Council member Scott Benson and his chief of staff, Carol Banks (the same Carol Banks paid $18K+ by Save Detroit Jobs).

FBI agents seized:

  • Bank records
  • Campaign finance records
  • 501(c)(4) social welfare organization records

Source: Deadline Detroit — “The messy intersection of dark money and Detroit politics”

What the FBI Was Looking For

The FBI’s Detroit Field Office was investigating:

  • Towing corruption and council kickbacks
  • 501(c)(4) social welfare nonprofits as vehicles for corruption
  • Campaign finance violations

University of Michigan professor Erik Gordon told The Detroit News: “Two of Detroit’s constant abuses are towing and social welfare organizations. Those seem to be the perennial avenues for corruption in Detroit.”

VI. KENNETH DANIELS — The President Who Bought a Drug Dealer a Car

Kenneth Daniels, president of Save Detroit Jobs / Detroit Leaders, was a Michigan State Representative (D-Detroit).

In 2014, Daniels was charged with helping buy a Mercedes-Benz for a convicted drug dealer.

Source: Deadline Detroit

This is the same entity that:

  • Backed Latisha Johnson for city council
  • Has Moore as compliance officer
  • Was formed by Wilk at Dykema
  • Is connected to the FBI-raided council offices

The president of the dark money entity that put a person on Banks’ school board was charged with buying a car for a convicted drug dealer. Banks IS a convicted drug dealer (Holland). The pattern repeats across entities and across decades.

VII. THE QUESTION FOR LATISHA JOHNSON

Council Member Johnson, the following questions are a matter of public record:

  1. Did you know that Detroit Leaders (which backed your candidacy) was the renamed Save Detroit Jobs — a dark money entity connected to the FBI investigation into council corruption?

  2. Did you know that W. Alan Wilk — the Dykema attorney who formed Detroit Leaders — also formed Our Neighborhoods First, which backed candidates whose offices were raided by the FBI?

  3. Did you know that Renae Moore — the compliance officer for Detroit Leaders — manages 54+ political entities including one involved in a $1M money laundering complaint?

  4. Did you know that Kenneth Daniels — the president of the entity that supported you — was charged with buying a Mercedes for a convicted drug dealer?

  5. How did you come to sit on the PCA Board? Were you recruited? By whom?

  6. As PCA Board Secretary, you oversee the governance of a school run by a man with 9 criminal convictions whose financial gatekeeper is a convicted drug dealer. Did the board discuss this at any meeting?

  7. Your city council oversees DPSCD, which authorized Banks’ charter. You sit on both sides. Council authorizes the charter. You govern the school. Is there a conflict?
